# RewardsPro rebuild widget

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewards/extensions/rewards-widget)

Show a storefront buyer their tier, its cashback rate, their Shopify store credit and their progress to the next tier; invite guests to sign in with the base rate.

**Scope:** One app embed block for apps/rewards, with the released extension's identity (uid, handle, block file name, body target) so the merchant's embed survives. Not released: the live store runs apps/rewardspro's widget until the trimmed release (spec 8, phase 3), which waits for Yu's yes.

**Placement:** Extension without a package.json.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. 2026-11-05: built. Liquid prints no buyer details; a signed-in buyer's widget asks the app proxy once (8 s limit, no retry); a guest's reads the app's rewards.config metafield and asks no server. About 10 KB of JS and CSS, Light and Dark looks with a teal accent kept off text, English strings only.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Check it on the staging app at laptop and phone widths, then read the deploy output and version diff so the extension shows as updated, never created plus removed.
